{
  "phoneNote": "The pool imagery and wave motif feel tailored to swimming, but the tall hero and oversized time badge push practical details below the first screen.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized wave-and-headline composition leaves substantial unused space on the right and pushes the main hero button partly below the first screen.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,

  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Shorten the hero on both viewports: reduce the wave height, headline size and time badge so the primary action and a compact location summary fit comfortably within the first screen.",
    "Consolidate the repeated schedule and contact information into the hero summary and final contact section; remove the second time badge and redundant schedule rows elsewhere.",
    "Tighten vertical padding between lower sections, especially on mobile, and remove the large gap between the final contact block and footer."
  ]
}
